title: Fourier character of the Gaussian torus map
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $m:\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}\to\mathbb Z$, and let $x\in\mathbb R^n$. The Fourier character of the Gaussian torus image of $x$ is $\exp\!\left(i\sum_{j=1}^n2\pi\bigl(m_{j,0}+\sqrt2\,m_{j,1}\bigr)x_j\right)$.
